label: Imaging Procedure
description: Any technology or method that aids in the visualization of any biological process, cell, tissue or organ for use in screening, diagnosis, surgical procedures or therapy.

verification.note: Schema node representing raw and pre-processed image data; best NCIT match is Imaging Procedure as the general class. OBI:0003327 (image data set) is an alternative cross-reference.

label: Primary Key
description: The attribute selected as being most important for uniquely identifying a body of information (an entity, object or record).

verification.note: Primary Key is a direct match for a unique row identifier used as a primary key for record updates.

label: Lens Numerical Aperture
description: A number that characterizes the range of angles over which the objective lens can accept or emit light.

verification.note: No exact NCIT term for objective lens identifier. Lens Numerical Aperture is closely related to objective lens properties. This is a partial match used as the best available option.

label: Field of View
description: The area or angular extent of the observable world as seen from a particular viewpoint.

verification.note: No exact NCIT term for nominal magnification. NCIT:C74298 Field of View is related but not identical. CDE:7788940 is noted in the existing model. Searching for a better magnification term.

label: Lens Numerical Aperture
description: A number that characterizes the range of angles over which the objective lens can accept or emit light.

verification.note: Lens Numerical Aperture is a direct match for the numerical aperture of the lens.

label: Working Distance
description: The distance between the front end of the objective lens and the specimen surface when the specimen is in focus.

verification.note: Working Distance is a direct match for the working distance of the lens.

label: Unit of Length
description: An indication of the type of unit of measure being used to express a length or distance.

verification.note: Unit of Length is a direct match for the units of the working distance (e.g. microns).

label: Immersion Medium
description: A fluid used to fill the space between a microscope's objective lens and the coverslip. It is used to increase the effective numerical aperture of the lens.

verification.note: Immersion Medium is a direct match for the immersion medium / immersion type attribute.

label: Field of View
description: The area or angular extent of the observable world as seen from a particular viewpoint.

verification.note: No exact NCIT term for FOV index. Field of View (NCIT:C74298) is the parent concept. Index represents the sequence ordering of FOV.

label: Big Endian Byte Order
description: A binary number consisting of multiple bytes in which the most significant bit is encoded first with the remaining bytes encoded in decreasing order of significance.

verification.note: Big Endian Byte Order is a direct match for the Image Pixels BigEndian boolean attribute indicating byte order.
